未来计划What’s Ahead

我们不画空头时间表，只定一个规矩：前一步真正稳妥好用了，再往后走下一步。 No empty deadlines—one simple promise: every step becomes truly dependable before we start the next.

第一阶段 · 先让它真正信得过Stage 1 · Built to Trust

现在正在走In progress

公开发布与日常打磨Public Release & Daily Polish

当前阶段Now

在 Mac、Android、iPhone 与 iPad 上顺畅完成阅读、听书、划线、外文查词与个人网盘同步。Smooth everyday reading, listening, highlighting, lookup, and private cloud sync across desktop and mobile.

更好听的本机离线声音Richer Offline Voices

下一步Next

让新装好语阅的人第一次点开朗读，就能听到自然温暖的人声，不再是机械的系统朗读；并逐步完善手机端分角色朗读体验。Natural, warm offline voices right out of the box—no robotic defaults—plus expressive multi-voice narration on mobile.

滴水不漏的数据稳妥Rock-Solid Reliability

1.0

反复验证换版本不丢笔记、断网多端编辑不覆盖、无障碍读屏与大字体体验，同时提供更省心的安装渠道。Zero lost notes across upgrades or offline edits, full accessibility polish, and easier installation channels.

第二阶段 · 把「听、读、记」做到极致Stage 2 · Going Deeper

逐词高亮与边听边盲划Word-Level Follow & Eyes-Free Highlights

听书时不用掏出手机看屏幕，按一下耳机键就能把刚才那一句划下来；支持听外文原声对照中文译文、单句跟读对比，生词本里还能回放书里那一句原声。Press your headphone button to highlight the sentence you just heard without looking at a screen; listen in the original language beside translations and replay vocabulary in context.

让读过的书真正留下来Remembering What You Read

读完一本书后，自动把你的划线、想法、生词与收听时长排成清爽的「一本书的一页」留作纪念；支持按意思在全书库搜索旧笔记，也把纸书手记做得更顺手。A clean single-page summary of your highlights, thoughts, and words when you finish a book—plus meaning-based search across all your notes and richer paper-book logs.

第三阶段 · 陪你去到更多地方Stage 3 · More Places to Read

车载、手表、小组件与墨水屏Car, Watch, Widgets & E-Ink

开车时支持 CarPlay 与 Android Auto 接着听，抬腕用手表切句划线，桌面小组件安静展示今天的一条旧划线，还有专为墨水屏准备的无动画界面。CarPlay & Android Auto for drives, watch remote for skipping and marking, calm desktop widgets, and a dedicated zero-animation e-ink interface.

上架应用商店 · Windows 与 Linux 桌面版App Stores · Windows & Linux

让更多人不用折腾安装包就能一键装上语阅，并把同样安静顺手的阅读与同步体验带到 Windows 与 Linux 电脑。One-click store installs without compromising openness, alongside Windows and Linux desktop apps synced seamlessly with your phone.

“永远不做：账号系统、自己的服务器、收集数据、广告、书城、推荐流、社交。不是做不了，是做了就不是语阅了。” “Never building: accounts, our own servers, telemetry, ads, a bookstore, feeds, or social networks. Not because we can’t—because then it wouldn’t be Yuyue.”
